title: Meet San Diego-Based 'KID Comics' Creator, Keithan Jones!
description:
Meet the artist behind the limited-edition Comic-Con library card! Keithan Jones is the owner and founder of KID Comics, based in San Diego.

The library card is now available for pickup at all open San Diego Public Library locations, while supplies last. Card replacement fees are waived this month!

Have a Comic-Con badge? Swing by the SDPL booth #5523 to get this library card. On Saturday, July 25, Keithan will be visiting the booth at noon to sign them! Get the details: sandiego.gov/CCEL.

#SanDiego #CityOfSanDiego #ComicCon #SDCC
